Record Class MachineInspection

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
fr.robie.machineengine.api.machine.MachineInspection
Record Components:
type - machine type key (for placeholders: the missing type's key)
storages - contents per storage id
escrow - resources in flight to other regions, still owned by this machine
lockedSlots - slots holding data of unregistered resource types, per storage id
unknownData - ids of persisted data this machine type no longer declares (kept verbatim)
public record MachineInspection(@NotNull net.kyori.adventure.key.Key type, @NotNull WorldPosition position, @NotNull Direction facing, boolean placeholder, @NotNull SchedulerState state, @Nullable WakeReason lastWakeReason, @Nullable MachineError lastError, @NotNull Map<String, List<StorageView>> storages, @Nullable ProcessView process, @NotNull List<InstalledUpgrade> upgrades, @NotNull List<ResourceStack> escrow, @NotNull Map<String,Integer> lockedSlots, @NotNull List<String> unknownData) extends Record
Immutable snapshot of a machine for debugging and admin commands (ARCHITECTURE.md §27).

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
